portfolio.standardizedClassWeightedMarketCapNote: Not computed: the official publication prices only the most liquid class (ITSA4); no same-date ITSA3 price is published.

checks.name: Itaú Unibanco: market value = price × shares
Itaú Unibanco: stake = market value × ownership
Aegea: mixed-basis parts sum to value

diagnostics: Values mix bases as published by Itaúsa (market price, capital-increase price, book value, booked fair value); they are not homogeneous.
Itaúsa's market value prices every share (ON and PN) at the most liquid class (ITSA4) — the issuer's own method.

unlistedInvestmentValue.note: Investees valued by the issuer at transaction price, book value or booked fair value

largestInvesteeConcentration.note: Share of positive investee value: largest investee / Σ positive investee values (excludes net cash and other assets/liabilities; not a share of the net sum of the parts)

holdingCash.note: Statement cash: CVM 1.01.01, parent-only; excludes investments booked under 1.01.02

netDebt.note: Statement net debt: gross debt − statement cash; negative = net cash. Not the issuer-published net cash of the portfolio publication

officialDiscount.note: Issuer-published structural metric (market value / portfolio value − 1); not a valuation

standardizedClassWeightedMarketCap.note: Not computed: the official publication prices only the most liquid class (ITSA4); no same-date ITSA3 price is published.
